title: Austin Growth and Major Property Sale
summary:
*   **City Expansion:** Two ordinances were passed to expand Austin's municipal boundaries, annexing over 134 acres of additional territory.
*   **Major Property Sale:** The city authorized the sale of a significant tract of land from the Butler Tract on Lamar Boulevard to N.J. Ferris for $48,000.
*   **Taxi Driver Permit Revoked:** A taxicab driver's permit was revoked based on a recommendation from the Chief of Police.

Thereupon Mayor Miller announced that the ordinance had been finally passed.
Councilman Bartholomew moved that, upon the recommendation of the Chief of Police, the

Councilman Glass offered the following resolution and moved its adoption:
(RESOLUTION)
BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: THAT Tom Miller, Mayor, be and
he is hereby authorized and directed, in behalf of the City of Austin, to enter into an
agreement with N.J.FERRIS for the sale by the City of Austin to the said N. J. Ferris of
approximately 250 feet by 314 feet of land out of the Butler Tract on Lamar Boulevard, for
a cash consideration of $48,000.00, said agreement to be substantially in the following
terms:
MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT
MADE this 24th day of December, 1947, by and between the City of Austin, referred to as
"Seller, and N. J. Ferris, referred to as "Purchaser".
The City of Austin hereby agrees to sell, and N. J. Ferris hereby agrees to purchase, for
the sum of $48,000.00 cash, a tract of land fronting 250 feet on the west side of Lamar
Boulevard south of the Colorado River, being approximately 314 feet deep on the north side
and 357 feet deep on the south side.
1846
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
1846
The City of Austin agrees to furnish a good merchantable title and hereby acknowledges
receipt of the check in the amount of $5,000.00 as a payment by the Purchaser to bind this
sale, and said sale shall be consummated within thirty days from this date, and the
remaining $43,000.00 shall be paid to the City of Austin in cash at the time deed to the
property is made by the Seller.
Taxes shall be pro rated as of the date of sale.
The City Council in a scheduled meeting in the City Hall has authorized and this agreement
is executed by both parties hereto.
(Sgd) TOM MILLER, MAYOR
11 N. J. FERRIS.
Which motion, carrying with it the adoption of the resolution, carried by the following
vote: Ayes: Councilmen Bartholomew, Glass, Johnson, Mayor Miller, and Councilman
Thornberry
Noes: None
There being no further business, Councilman Bartholomew moved that the meeting be recessed
to January 8, 1948. The motion carried by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen
Bartholomew, Glass, Johnson, Mayor Miller, and Councilman Thornberry
Noes: None
The meeting was then recessed.
